section: Iterate — change: run the security scan weekly
title: Run security.yml weekly on a schedule and fail closed when a scanner does not report
context: The compliance grade's Security dimension reads only the latest successful security.yml run on main, and the workflow was manual-only, so the result went stale and the 2027-05-01 accepted-risk expiry would go unnoticed.
decision: Activate a Monday 06:00 UTC schedule (pull_request stays off), require all three scanner SARIF reports in the critical gate, and stop persisting the checkout token.
consequences: A green weekly run now means a complete scan; a scanner crash or failed install fails the run and emails whoever last edited the cron line. Sub-9.0 findings, including expired accepted risks, do not fail a run. Semgrep and Trivy installs remain unpinned (follow-up card).
rationale: Without the per-scanner check, a rate-limited Trivy download would leave a green run the compliance tooling counts as a complete current scan.
rejected: Also turning on pull_request scans (not requested); pinning Semgrep/Trivy in this change (separate follow-up).
